name: Takayama Kouta
source:
A tough man who wears casual clothes.
Appears to be neutral, making it unclear if he can be trusted or not.

While not particularly inclined to kill, will not waver if the need arises.
Ironically, his dryness makes him rather persuasive.

"I think it would be in our best interests to co-operate. What do you guys think?"

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=614865]Getchu[/url]]
